engineRevision: 41bc17b + new opt-in audit tests (shipped bytes unchanged)
scope: GEOMETRY ONLY — collision-graph connectivity. No survival, hazard tolerance, hunger/thirst/warmth, creature, stamina, clock, vehicle/ferry or return-trip model.

continuityRule.note: The window slides by SLIDE_STEP tiles when the player comes within EDGE_MARGIN tiles of an interior edge; origins are clamped to [0, FRAME-WINDOW].

predicates.foot: blockGrid class 0 or 4 — exactly the engine movement rule !blockedAt (blockedAt blocks {1,2,3,5,6}); wading allowed, same predicate as engine spawnWindowExitReachMask
predicates.dry: blockGrid class 0 and tile not in {DEEP, SHALLOW, RIVER}
predicates.footDoors: foot, plus class-3 cells that are real POI door tiles (a walking player can open a door)
predicates.source: per-cell class read from the engine blockGrid of a real RunState in the covering window

notes: Mosaic cells are PRISTINE compiled windows with no run deltas; each cell keeps the reading from the window where it is most interior.
Windows are entered with a QA inspection landing (qaUsed=true) only so the real collision grid exists; the single player-route fact is the normal start, which must have qaUsed=false.
A reachable path is NOT a survivable route and NOT a playable claim; hazard and water composition of every path is reported so the survival question stays visible.
Software-rendered fixture build in a test environment: never release-readiness evidence.

slideMechanism.called: maybeSlideVeyraWindow(gs, markDirty) — the function the game calls each tick
slideMechanism.note: Proves the mosaic lattice is the real streaming lattice: origins move in SLIDE_STEP quanta and the player global tile is preserved across the boundary.

windowAgreement.interpretation: A mismatch means the SAME global tile compiles to a different engine collision class in two windows that both cover it, i.e. the continuous world is not perfectly origin-independent. The margin buckets say whether that is a window-seam artefact (margin 0-2) or spread through the overlap.
windowAgreement.note: Full-overlap comparison of real 64-tile-stride neighbour windows (136x200 or 200x136 cells each), read through the engine collision grid of a real run in each window.
